'''Achi Clan''' (阿智氏, ''Achi-uji'') is a {{ill|Clan|en|Clan|qid=Q211503|lt=clan}} named after "Achi."
== Origins ==
According to the "Tenjin Honki" section of the {{ill|Kujiki|en|Kujiki|qid=Q2716751|lt=Sendai Kuji Hongi}}, {{ill|Uwaharu and Shitaharu|ja|天表春命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Uwaharu no Mikoto|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Uwaharu no Mikoto|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=ウワハル・シタハル|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=ウワハル・シタハル|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10940723}}, a son of {{ill|Yagokoro Omoikane no Kami|ja|八意思兼神}}, is cited as the ancestor of the '''Shinano no Achi Hōribe''' (信乃阿智祝部). His brother, {{ill|Uwaharu and Shitaharu|ja|天下春命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Shitaharu no Mikoto|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Shitaharu no Mikoto|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=ウワハル・シタハル|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=ウワハル・シタハル|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10940723}}, is named as the ancestor of the {{ill|Chichibu Province|ja|武蔵秩父国造|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Musashi Chichibu no Kuni no Miyatsuko|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Musashi Chichibu no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=知々夫国造|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=知々夫国造|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q5096034}}.
== History ==
{{ill|Achi Shrine (Achi Village)|ja|阿智神社 (阿智村)}} preserves a tradition stating that in the fifth year of {{ill|Emperor Kōgen|en|Emperor Kōgen|qid=Q333572|lt=Emperor Kōgen}}, in the first month of spring, {{ill|Yagokoro Omoikane no Mikoto|ja|八意思兼命}} descended into Shinano Province with accompanying deities and enshrined there.
